decision.reasoning_trace: I prioritized audio performance, durability, and battery life in my search. My consideration set included top-rated models from JBL and Harman Kardon, as well as a more rugged Altec Lansing and a budget-friendly Raymate. I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because it offers a near-perfect balance of features: an IP67 waterproof rating, a massive 20-hour battery life, and a built-in powerbank for charging other devices. With over 16,000 reviews and a 4.8-star rating, it represents the most reliable purchase for high-quality portable sound.
